- `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.github/pull_request_template.md`

- `docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001-tracker-3t-siw.md`

It explicitly identifies absent FCal/muon systems and incomplete acceptance. All 69 source/input hashes from the [DES026 tracker snapshot](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/4e44d7c650ac0a2931f7fc1637b5b3f2dfbe4c95/docs/validation/DES-026/tracker-rz.json) match the assigned main revision.

Actual checks passed: 13 pinned source hashes; 69 tracker input hashes; 33 local Markdown links/images; ECAL/HCAL dimensions against existing `assembly.inventory()`; deterministic SVG/XML check; `git diff --check`. Rendered using existing `rsvg-convert` and visually inspected the PNG. GitHub API confirmed PR58 merged and PR64/70 open at their pinned heads.

Coordinator action remains: replace PR71’s “forthcoming” wording and null head revision after creation; add its final DES/source pin and reconcile any changed barrel bounds. **Regenerate SVG and PNG after JSON changes** because the SVG metadata includes the input hash.

No commits, pushes, PR creation, geometry simulation, dependency installation or project/journal edits performed. Token counters unavailable.
